description: Hey! I’m Moza Qambar , I’m passionate about communication, leadership, teamwork, and thinking outside the box. I’m looking for creative, ambitious teammates who love challenges, science, and sharing ideas. If you’re ready to build, compete, and aim for something BIG !! join my team! 🚀🚀
summary:
Our NASA project is all about how robotic spacecrafts have helped scientists to find out the secrets of space. The two missions we're looking at are the Opportunity rover on Mars and Surveyor 3 on the Moon.

We put together an educational presentation which featured a realistic landscape, rover model, genuine NASA photos and the scientific evidence. The visitor becomes a space investigator in the process of looking at the clues, working through the challenges and discovering what the robots have actually found out about these other worlds.

Our project is about taking the difficulty of space discovery and making it something that's actually interesting and fun. Opportunity found evidence that liquid water once existed on Mars, which would suggest that Mars may have had the right conditions for life. Surveyor 3 looked at the Moon’s surface and was very useful to NASA in the planning of future human landings.

This project majors on how robotic exploration can help us understand the past, make discoveries and prepare for the future. The key goal is to stimulate curiosity and to prove that even the smallest clues from space can lead to huge discoveries.
details:
Orbital Mission is an interactive website we've put together to make learning about space exploration a bit more fun and interesting. It's all about two NASA missions: the Opportunity rover on Mars and Surveyor 3 on the Moon. You can go around and explore the different environments, find out all sorts of facts, look at the images and do a range of interactive activities to get to know the missions better.

We wanted to do something that went beyond just reading. We wanted to create an experience where you could go on an adventure and learn as you went. The aim is to make space science accessible to students and the younger generation in particular and to hopefully spark an interest in space and in NASA’s discoveries.

To build our website we used a range of tools including Canva, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT plus specifically to assist us with the coding, the problem solving, the design improvements and the development of our ideas. We used Netlify to publish the website.

What makes our project different is that we've actually got real NASA missions integrated with the interactive learning. We've tried to make it both an educational and an enjoyable experience rather than just another site full of information.

We've been very much focused throughout the project on making it easy to use, attractive to look at, scientifically accurate and accessible. We've also been very much aware that people might not have any background in space at all and wanted to make sure they could enjoy using the site.

Overall we hope Orbital Mission helps people to learn something new, become a bit more curious about space and get a better appreciation of just how important these missions have been to space exploration.
